Summary: Mid-market SaaS (customer support platform) evaluating Redwood. Started with Hosted API POC in Dec 2025; moved to performance demo Jan 2026; now running Dedicated POC and going through security review for VPC/private control plane.

Key business driver: want consistent sub-150ms median token latency for live chat flows and predictable unit cost as usage ramps; strong emphasis on auditability and residency for EU customers. Team prefers open-model variants but needs Redwood to guarantee fallback routing when Dedicated capacity saturated.

POC scope so far: ingest historical support transcripts, validate embeddings search (semantic doc search), run a small chat assistant integrated into their agent UI. Observations: batching + KV cache gave 2.3x token cost reduction in test harness; live chat latency spiky under 95th pct because of occasional long-context compiles.

Security/Compliance thread: Security questionnaire submitted 2026-02-02. Main asks: SOC2 report for Dedicated, SSO (Okta SAML) integration pattern, audit log format and retention controls, KMS support and BYOK, network isolation (VPC peering/private control plane), data residency options for EU. Legal asked for breach notification SLA and sub-processor list.

Quotes/feedback: "We like the routing/fallback story — critical for our peak windows — but cannot move to Dedicated until SOC2 evidence and SSO flow are signed off." — CTO (Lena Ortiz).

Sales readout: AE Jordan running commercial threads; SE Leila on technical POC; Solutions architect provided config that shows autoscale plus burst to handle 4x baseline traffic. Provided draft pricing table v1 (drive link).

Next demo items: 1) security Q&A w/ infra & legal, 2) live SSO test using dev Okta tenant, 3) Dedicated perf run with long-context churn (simulate agent sessions).
